advisories.text: Review the mitigation backlog: drainage upgrade is overdue and equipment elevation is accepted. Confirm critical-supplier stock cover of at least 5 days.
Inspect the MCC panel and pumps, verify generator fuel for 12 h autonomy, move raw stock off the ground floor.
Secure roof sheets and outdoor items, brief shift emergency roles, prepare controlled shutdown of the CNC line.
Execute controlled shutdown and isolate the MCC panel. Follow official instructions.
Follow official emergency instructions, account for all staff, do not re-energise flooded equipment.
Record damage, downtime and response timings in the Resilience Ledger and start the outcome review.
Review inhibitor dosing and the tank temperature log during idle storage; vapour detector calibration is overdue.
Verify refrigeration redundancy and alarm set-points; brief night-shift emergency roles.
Move tank temperature checks to hourly, pre-stage inhibitor and notify the district control-room liaison.
Start the emergency inhibitor step in the site SOP and prepare the community warning. Follow official instructions.
Sound the siren, notify the community and evacuate per the emergency plan. Follow official instructions.
Log the release timeline, response timings and community impact; begin the regulatory and outcome review.
